evals.prompt: Design order processing where payment webhooks can be delivered repeatedly and our database commits can fail. We have one app and Postgres; no proven scaling problem.
evals.expected_output: A small design with explicit transaction and external-effect boundaries.
expectations: Defines durable idempotency and crash-after-commit behavior.
Does not add a queue/service solely for hypothetical scale or promise exactly-once from delivery semantics.

evals.prompt: Our mobile clients stay offline for days and cannot all update together. Design an API field change from full_name to structured names.
evals.expected_output: Compatible old/new contracts and offline conflict semantics.
expectations: Accounts for old clients, data conversion ambiguity, and rollout coexistence.
Identifies irreversible data transformations and validation evidence.
